The built Rust CLI is tested directly with empty inherited environment and PATH: all 135 inputs, single/batch equivalence, 1000/1001-item and 1 MiB input limits, malformed JSON/UTF-8, deterministic output and ordered per-item errors. The remaining Python gate and governance tests only delegate to the Rust result; no validation policy is duplicated. Static integrity is not target qualification.

Rust records validates all six original MTM-003 through MTM-008 accepted receipt identities and exact counts after baseline-bound hash validation. Original bytes and hashes remain unchanged. No historical release is rerun or promoted to current qualification, and target-specific validators outside this responsibility remain pending.
